headline: Bus seats scorched in attempted arson attack in Dhaka's Mirpur
summary: Perpetrators poured petrol on a passenger bus and attempted to set it alight late Saturday night. Staff quickly extinguished the flames, preventing a major disaster.
details: A group of people on a motorcycle allegedly attempted to set fire to a Bihanga Paribahan passenger bus in Dhaka's Mirpur-12 on Saturday night. The incident occurred around 10 PM near the Pallabi Metro Station.

The perpetrators poured petrol on the rear of the bus and attempted to set it alight before fleeing the scene. Several seats inside the bus were scorched before the bus staff managed to put out the flames.

Pallabi Police Station chief Md Jalal Uddin confirmed the incident, stating that the fire was extinguished immediately. "The bus has since been removed. A few seats were burnt. Those who attempted to set the fire have fled," he said.

headline_marked: Thousands join PM as [[BNP celebrates Revolution and Solidarity Day]]
headline: Thousands join PM as BNP celebrates Revolution and Solidarity Day
summary: The Prime Minister led a massive procession in Dhaka to mark the historic November 7, emphasizing national unity and the 'Bangladesh comes first' sentiment.
details: The Prime Minister led thousands of participants in a large-scale procession to celebrate Revolution and Solidarity Day on November 7.
The event was marked by rallies, tributes, and fanfare, as the BNP aimed to make the historic date significant once again.
During the celebrations, the core message emphasized that 'Bangladesh comes first,' highlighting a call for national priority and unity.
The day is observed to commemorate the historical events of November 7, serving as a as a point of solidarity among the participants.
The processions and rallies took place across the city, drawing a large crowd of supporters and supporters of the party.
